title: Split Deadline Alerts into core and task-sdk components

target.summary: In `AverageRuntimeDeadline._evaluate_with`, database duration queries can return `Decimal` values, causing `timedelta(seconds=avg_duration_seconds)` to raise a `TypeError` when calculating the deadline.
notes: faulty statement passing Decimal avg_duration_seconds to timedelta which raises TypeError

siblings.summary: `decode_deadline_alert` resolves reference classes exclusively via `SerializedReferenceModels.get_reference_class`, which raises `ValueError` for custom deadline references registered via `DeadlineReference.register_custom_reference`.
notes: faulty statements resolving reference_type using get_reference_class which only handles built-in reference classes
copy of the same faulty pattern calling get_reference_class which cannot resolve custom reference classes
definition of get_reference_class helper that only looks up built-in reference classes and raises ValueError for custom classes
encoding functions that serialize references without preserving class path for custom classes
